title: Outline, Then Details: Syntactically Guided Coarse-To-Fine Code Generation

layout.note: Three stacked full-width bands with bold monospace headings: problem text; four code windows in a row, each with its arrow, tile row and name; and a long target strip with two braces beneath. Pale coloured lines fan from each tile row to its slot in the strip.

lesson: Explain a data-formulation idea by redrawing one real example (here a code listing) in a row of identical windows, each highlighting a different token class in its own colour, then carry that colour onto the tiles and the final concatenated strip so the reader sees what ends up where.
